prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.)
text: Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. The other vehicle struck our client's vehicle, and our client has since sought medical treatment for significant injuries. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, must be directed to this office and not to our client. Please provide the policy limits of liability coverage under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that your insured, its agents, and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics information, claim file materials, and any recorded statements. Please confirm in writing within ten days that you have received this letter and that the requested preservation steps have been taken.
